rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for this — really glad the meetup conversation landed. Here's something concrete: Halcyon Threshold's near-term focus is picking one narrow, currently-neglected thing to measure about AI models/agents (a specific failure mode, capability, or risk) and building a small, reproducible evaluation for it — the kind of project that's genuinely useful precisely because almost nobody has done it yet. With your data background, the most valuable first step would be a short landscape scan: what evals/benchmarks already exist in the space we're considering, where the gaps are, and which gap looks both important and tractable for a tiny, part-time team to tackle first. That directly determines what we build next. Would you be up for a first pass on that over the next couple of weeks? Happy to hop on a call to narrow down candidate topics together before you dig in, if that's useful. Thanks again for reaching out, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (offered help) with a concrete task: scanning the existing evals landscape to help pick our first project. Sent.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "halcyon-threshold-weekly-scan" (0 14 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set up a weekly automated scan (Mondays) that reviews inbox/web for new relevant opportunities/deadlines and reports to you
